# YouTube Live channels for the ytblive workflow.
# Format:  name=url   (one channel per line; "name" becomes the .m3u8 filename)
# Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Cookie (secrets.YOUTUBE_COOKIES) is REQUIRED — without it yt-dlp cannot grab live streams.
# To add / update a channel, just edit this file; the workflow reads it on every run.
